shared_filter: check_delivery.py actual prepare_records; inputs and accepted records independently tested

controls.explanation: Two source profiles produce identical normalized bank arrangements. Their duplicate controls merge; every eligible target and all five option positions survive.

learner_selection: Read engine/rust/question_selection.rs: configured weights choose a difficulty band then sample candidates uniformly within it. All prospective records are easy; no bank- or target-based weighting exists. seen_before_task and current-prefix exclusion are learner-specific. Without configured weights, selector takes the first candidate.
limits: No learner history, live inventory changes, or reservation state supplied; not an end-to-end live selection claim. A single draw cannot demonstrate pool-level role variation.
